profile.headline: Software Engineer at The University of Oklahoma Foundation
profile.summary: Motivated Software Developer with multiple years of experience working in the .NET framework using both C# and VB.NET with strong oral and written communication skills, the ability to establish rapport with diverse individuals, strong work ethic, and extremely dependable.  In addition, professional experience on a software development team as well as working independently on software development projects.  Finally, enjoy seeking out new challenges and finding solutions to meet the needs of colleagues and customers both internal and external.

company.name: The University of Oklahoma Foundation, Inc.

positions.title: Applications Specialist
positions.description:
•	Maintain internal applications utilizing Microsoft Access/Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
•	Maintain internal and external applications utilizing the .NET Framework, VB.NET, C#, and SQL Server. 
•	Assist with developing/implementing new applications/re-writes in .NET.
•	Assist with Microsoft Access rewrites in .Net Core, Blazor, SQL Server and SQL Server Reporting Services.
•	Meet with end users to discuss application and business requirements. 
•	Train users on new/rewritten applications.

company.name: State of Oklahoma Office of Management and Enterprise Services

positions.title: Application Support Administrator
positions.description:
•	Responsible for running proprietary software for the purpose of installations, upgrades, configurations and technical troubleshooting digital order data.
•	Liaison between software developers and customers to ensure requirements are clearly defined and integrated. 
•	Assist with developing and implementing policies and procedures. 
•	Create and maintain detailed documentation for internal and external applications and procedures. 
•	Perform Microsoft SharePoint administrator duties.
•	Assist with Remedy tickets as needed.
